item.title: Your backup is someone else's computer. What if it were everyone's?
item.description: Every guide to backups repeats the same rule: three copies, two media, one somewhere else. But what did you actually buy from a cloud provider? Seven principles for storage worth trusting, the story behind a community-run network, and why any organization sitting on idle disks can fork it.
